$comment: Domestic corporation income tax parameters (CREATE / CREATE MORE era). Draft pending research reconciliation.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 27(A), as amended by RA 11534 (CREATE)
rcit.notes: 20% applies when net taxable income ≤ ₱5M AND total assets ≤ ₱100M (excluding the land where the business sits). CREATE MORE (RA 12066) also gives 20% to registered business enterprises under the enhanced-deduction regime.

value.startsInTaxableYear: 4th taxable year immediately following the year operations began

mcit.notes: Pay the higher of RCIT and MCIT (2% of gross income) from the fourth taxable year after the registration year. Excess MCIT over RCIT credits against RCIT for the next three years.

fiscalYear.value: Corporations may adopt a fiscal year; individuals must use the calendar year
fiscalYear.notes: Quarterly returns fall 60 days after each fiscal quarter; the annual return falls on the 15th day of the 4th month after fiscal year-end.

osdCorporate.notes: Corporations compute OSD on gross income (after cost of sales), unlike individuals who use gross sales/receipts.
